executive_assessment.text: Mean annual warming is projected at 1.1–3.0°C by the 2060s and 1.6–5.3°C by the 2090s, fastest in the north and northwest; 2041–50 dry/hot and wet/warm cases differ in both temperature and rainfall.
Without accelerated adaptation, modelled 2050 GDP losses reach 11.6% under dry/hot conditions and 2.5% under wet/warm conditions.
The NDC names Conakry, Forécariah, Boffa, and Kamsar as exposed to coastal inundation, erosion, and saline intrusion; it calls for risk mapping and 5,000 hectares of mangrove restoration.

geographic_notes.text: Guinea; Northern Guinea; Northwestern Guinea: Mean annual warming is projected at 1.1–3.0°C by the 2060s and 1.6–5.3°C by the 2090s, fastest in the north and northwest; 2041–50 dry/hot and wet/warm cases differ in both temperature and rainfall.

Guinea; Conakry: The NDC says climate impacts interact with socioeconomic fragilities and contribute to internal mobility toward Conakry; it describes migration as a frequently cited adaptation strategy.

Conakry; Forécariah; Boffa; Kamsar: The NDC names Conakry, Forécariah, Boffa, and Kamsar as exposed to coastal inundation, erosion, and saline intrusion; it calls for risk mapping and 5,000 hectares of mangrove restoration.

Guinea; Communes and local areas: For 2026–2035, the NDC proposes interministerial and municipal coordination, local contingency plans, inclusive committees with at least 40% women, and linked early-warning and assistance protocols.

known_gaps.text: The climate knowledge portal page and 2026 national adaptation plan could not be substantively opened; neither is used as claim evidence.
The CCDR fragility statement is qualitative and does not estimate a climate-caused conflict effect.
Government-reported flood impacts and proposed adaptation measures were not independently validated.
Draft collection pending human source review and approval. IDA eligibility is not an FCV classification.
National and selected local examples do not establish district-level coverage or causal attribution.
The bank contains no completed mediated climate-FCV pathway; this is an evidence gap, not evidence of absence.
